scope: Whole upstream repository synchronization; rule datasets, new Steam variants and source documentation; personalized AllInOne runtime unchanged.
manual_review_decisions: Read actual old/new source bodies and active-line deltas from 581 Git-blob-verified versions. The complete trees show 292 rule/ changes: 289 modified files and three new Steam_Resolve lists, no removals or mode changes. All non-rule upstream entries are identical; preserve every personal path in the conflict-free whole-tree merge.

Advertising_All adds 5393/removes 910 domain rules, while AdvertisingTest adds 2951/removes 727. Retain the upstream exact DOMAIN versus DOMAIN-SUFFIX distinction and its different AdGuard normalization. Do not claim independent correctness or client effectiveness for every upstream domain. Seven DOMAIN-SET deltas match normalized full-rule deltas.

ChinaIPs adds 30/removes 23 IPv4/IPv6 ranges; ChinaIPsTest adds 56/removes 42. Read the 211.161 aggregation, 223.122 subdivisions, 43.125 aggregation, 59.111 changes and 2405:84c0/2406:840/240a:2001 IPv6 splits. Preserve each native no-resolve and no-IPv6 variant; strict CIDR validation passes. ChinaMax-family adds szu.app/szu.moe and adjusts eight IP rows in each direction.

Steam and Game each add dota2.com, steamconnecttest.com, valve.net and twelve IPv4 ranges. Read all three new Steam_Resolve lists: they are byte-identical, with 69 rows, and differ from Steam.list only by omitted no-resolve flags. Check the eight actual new README instructions explicitly rather than treating them as timestamp-only metadata. Other README changes are dates/counts.

Global adds 51 suffixes and removes none, including Claude/Anthropic, Fluxer, Postman, Safety, Thunderstore, steamos.cloud and worldofwarships.asia entries. AdGuard Lite/Privacy active data and Surge AdvertisingLite files are unchanged; Apple/Blizzard changes are metadata-only. Preserve all platform representations verbatim, without conversion.

All 52 changed native Surge lists validate: 30186 changed domain/keyword variant rows and 708 CIDR variant rows, with 61 parsed YAML payloads. Actual Steam documentation additions have a bounded reviewed allowlist in the validator; unknown prose still fails. Count changes are evidence accompanying source reading, not automatic semantic approval.

AllInOne original/personalized bytes, runtime scripts, licenses and workflows are unchanged. Two runtime dependencies match both mutable and current pinned upstream URLs and compile without execution. Existing ICU tests preserve exactly the two user-confirmed advertisement/advertising Pinterest and Pinimg authority exclusions, their capture groups and all other behavior.

Clarify obsolete website-retirement notes in personal AGENTS and current synchronization instructions, reflecting the user-authorized restored website and paused cloud migration. This fork synchronization does not deploy the website or alter wool_scripts. Website checks retain both DiDi repairs and independent client states, with no new Kelee/fmz membership or dependency changes.

Publish through the GitHub connector with the current fork head as expected lease and both fork/upstream commit parents. Preserve all personal files and historical reviews; never reset, force push, enable workflows or operate a client device.
